methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Can the production research/complex-frame-pair-decoders/verify.py:frame_pair_solutions adopt the proved exact eight-bit neighborhood enumerator from research/frame-pair-enumeration-fast-seed93/ so that the shipped PR968 D/E/H frame-pair census is faster while every ordered solution stream and term-rank receipt stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, data_corners, clifford_exact, bit-hosted-digest, emitted-local hpe_audit_local, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. A cyclic-zero production probe on this host measured only 1.26x and was deferred. woklerx's merged #1099 opt-in adapter already proved ~4.57x kernel / ~2.97x D/E/H with identical receipts; production frame_pair_solutions still rebuilt partner lists by nested list comprehensions. This session wires that equivalent rewrite into the shipped PR968 verifier, vendors pairwise baselines, demotes dependent VERIFY live pins to provenance, and retargets selected-p104-port-adapter's E8 model pin to the vendored baseline.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the PR968 frame-pair census is a retained exact historical check used by later P104/P112 packages. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production frame_pair_solutions neighborhood change with frozen baseline, identical D/E/H receipts, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median >=~1.5x with non-trivial absolute seconds. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_FRAME_PAIR_ENUMERATION_PRODUCTION via research/frame-pair-enumeration-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_FRAME_PAIR_ENUMERATION_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via taskset -c 0 benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 13.642→4.421 s, 3.086×); dependent VERIFY packages demote the live verify.py pin to provenance; selected-p104-port-adapter, p104-nullpair-compensated-shear-seed318bd5, and p104-term-shear-seed8be7 retarget live pairwise model pins to baseline.py; legacy loaders p104-asynchronous-carrier-bound, root-pair-first-drop-seed48, complex-decoder-field-extension-seed44, and e8-factor-linear-overcomplete47 load baseline.py; frame-pair-enumeration-fast-seed93 vendors baseline.py.
